author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices steady beat, high and low, loud and soft, stop and go, tapping the words and playing together, with a woolly sheep.

classes.title: Sway with the sheep
classes.goal: Hear the whole song and sway to its steady beat together.

mathTarget.parentLine: Feeling something that comes again and again, evenly spaced

classes.parentPrompt: Hold your child on your lap and sway side to side on every beat.
classes.childAction: Sway, clap and pat your knees with the song.
classes.bridge: The beat is the sheep's slow walk: step, step, step across the field.

intro.caption: Listen and sway
intro.parentCue: Hold your child close and sway on the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening and swaying to the beat.

classes.title: Sheep steps on the keys
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on every beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once on each beat. Any key is right.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one hoof step; the sheep never runs.

intro.caption: Tap on every beat
intro.parentCue: Tap your child's shoulder on each beat first

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: Bear low, bird high
classes.goal: Hear low and high sounds and tap the matching side of the piano.

mathTarget.parentLine: Low sounds live on the left, high sounds on the right

classes.parentPrompt: Growl and crouch for the bear; flap your arms and stretch up for the bird.
classes.childAction: Bear: tap the left side. Bird: tap the right side.
classes.bridge: Low notes are a heavy bear on the left; high notes are a tiny bird.

intro.caption: Here comes the bear, here comes the bird
intro.parentCue: Point left for bear, right for bird

games.caption: Big bear, down low
games.parentCue: Growl together, then tap the left side

games.caption: Little bird, up high
games.parentCue: Chirp together, then tap the right side

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing high and low sounds.

classes.title: Big baa, little baa
classes.goal: Tap the beat with big loud taps, then with tiny soft taps.

mathTarget.parentLine: Noticing big and small: the same tap, more or less

classes.parentPrompt: Say a big loud baa for loud taps and a tiny baa for soft taps.
classes.childAction: Loud: big sheep taps. Soft: tiny lamb taps.
classes.bridge: Loud taps are a big sheep calling; soft taps are a sleepy little lamb.

intro.caption: Big baa, little baa
intro.parentCue: Loud means strong arms, not banging

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing loud and soft.

classes.title: Turtle and bunny time
classes.goal: Follow the music as it slows like a turtle and speeds like a bunny.

mathTarget.parentLine: Same tune, same shape, only the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Walk your fingers up your child's back, slowly then quickly, matching the music.
classes.childAction: Turtle music: slow taps. Bunny music: quick taps.
classes.bridge: Slow taps are turtle steps; fast taps are bunny hops across the field.

intro.caption: Turtle slow, bunny fast
intro.parentCue: Slow down if the taps get wild

games.caption: Bunny sings baa baa
games.parentCue: Same song, now quick and light

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: following slow and fast music.

classes.title: Sheep, freeze!
classes.goal: Tap while the music plays and freeze when it stops.

mathTarget.parentLine: When the sound stops, the hands stop too

classes.parentPrompt: Freeze with a funny face when the music stops; cheer when it starts again.
classes.childAction: Tap while music plays. Freeze like a statue when it stops.
classes.bridge: Music on, the sheep walks; music off, the sheep stands still as a stone.

intro.caption: Go! Tap the beat
intro.parentCue: When the music stops, freeze with a silly face

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening for stop and go.

classes.title: Baa baa, tap tap
classes.goal: Tap once for each word, like baa, baa, two little taps.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each word you sing

classes.parentPrompt: Say the words slowly and tap your child's hand once per word.
classes.childAction: Baa baa: two taps, one for each baa.
classes.bridge: Each baa is one hoof print on the keys: two baas, two prints.

intro.caption: One tap for each baa
intro.parentCue: Say baa baa and tap twice

games.caption: Baa baa, yes sir
games.parentCue: Say each word with each light

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each word.

classes.title: Sheep field game mix
classes.goal: Listen and switch between games: high and low, loud and soft, fast and slow.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting each sound: high or low, loud or soft?

classes.parentPrompt: Pause before each picture and ask: bear or bird? Loud or soft? Then cheer.
classes.childAction: Guess the game, then tap high, low, loud, soft, slow or fast.
classes.bridge: Every sound wears a costume: bear, bird, big sheep, little lamb, turtle, bunny.

intro.caption: Bear or bird? Loud or soft?
intro.parentCue: Let your child guess first; any guess is fine

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling sounds apart and switching games.

classes.title: You and me, sheep duet
classes.goal: Make the song together: the grown-up plays the tune, the child keeps the beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two different jobs fit together to make one song

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and watch your child; if they stop, keep playing and smile.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat on any key while your grown-up plays.
classes.bridge: The sheep shares her wool; we share the song, one job each.

intro.caption: Play it together
intro.parentCue: Sit side by side, you on the tune

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, two jobs.

classes.title: Wool concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song from the first note to the last, then bow together.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song starts, goes on, and ends; we finish together

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play the tune, then clap, cheer and bow together.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat to the very end, then take a big bow.
classes.bridge: The song walks from the sheep all the way down the lane.

intro.caption: A song for teddy
intro.parentCue: Put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
